acceptance: Installs as an actual app on the target platform
Works locally without the discontinued production servers
Player can drive and drift in a solo race
Player can race against functioning AI opponents
Evidence of actual interactive gameplay, not just a splash screen or static asset view
Original gameplay, art, sound, physics and controls retained; no substitute kart simulator
Both speed and item races run locally with multiple AI, working laps, finish and results
Item races include functioning original items; no online multiplayer mode
intermediate_milestone: Load the retained iOS training map and establish local player control
preservation: Keep original installed app and data; modify and test an independent copy
status: The preserved iOS 2.71.1 client now loads Village_I01 in original SpeedSingleGameMode with one original player and three original RaceAiPawn/AIController opponents marked as AI. Original LoadItemListRule loads Dao, Cotton kart, animations and effects; the scene and race HUD render and phase reaches BeginRace. Original player vehicle drives. A guarded path-driver preservation patch resolves assist initialization destroying FollowTG; two independent position samples confirm all three original AI opponents continuously driving. Checkpoint initialization has no actors because the test IPA omitted pakchunk11, which contains the original BP_CheckPoint assets. That retained chunk and all four matching shader libraries are being included for another real-device test. No AI finish is verified. Screenshot orientation/camera, drifting, full AI races and item mode remain unverified. Device is an iPadOS 16.1 iPad, not an iPhone. Android and 2004 PC originals are preserved; no offline Android or native macOS/PC port is verified.

implementation.source: Reverse engineer and modify the preserved original client; do not substitute a newly written kart game. Write our analysis and patch tooling ourselves.
implementation.allowed_research: Study publicly described principles and validate behavior; implement our own code
implementation.platform_dependencies: Native operating-system SDKs, compilers and standard libraries
implementation.original_assets: Import retained original art and sound separately; do not publish original game assets as our source code
implementation.runtime: Original app executable, original engine, assets, physics, sound and gameplay. Offline startup and local AI race patches are the work to be completed.
